test_metadata.title: Communication Hold - WiFi to 3G: Originating party puts call on hold
test_metadata.objective: 1) Registered to IMS network (VoPS=1) on good cellular coverage 2) Call waiting enabled Note: Supplementry service settings can only be modified on non-VoWiFi i.e. VoLTE/LTE/3G

execution_procedure.instruction: 1) DUT and UE-2 are connected to WiFi coverage and register on VoWiFi
2) UE-1 is connected and registered to a 3G network
3) DUT initiates voice call to UE-1
4) UE-2 performs a voice call to DUT
5) DUT puts UE-1 on hold and answers the call from UE-2
6) DUT finishes the voice call with UE-2 and disconnects the call
Repeat 2nd iteration with the terminating party putting the call on hold rather than the orginating party
DUT hangs the call from UE-1

checks: 1) Check active voice call in progress between DUT and UE-1
2)Speech is not present in UE-1 whilst on hold
3)Check UE-1 is on hold.
4) Ensure 2-way audio is present between DUT and UE-2
5) Ensure that the DUT resumes the call with UE-1
6) Verify Media exchange (IMS/SIP) message sequence
7) All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: Voice Call: VoWiFi--800--VoWiFi
test_metadata.objective: 1) DUT has performed a PS attach and registered onto a VoWiFi with IMS VoPS flag indicating IMS supported , but is in the vicinity of a LTE VoPS=1 cell. WiFi: Good Cellular: None > LTE VoPS=1 > None

execution_procedure.instruction: 1. Initiate an MO voice call(VoWiFi. from the DUT to UE
2. Move the UE into an area with good coverage LTE VoPS=1 cell.
4. End voice call 1 minute after handover is completed

checks: 1. The DUT should be connected without losing service
2. Following the call transition of the DUT from VoWiFi to LTE VoPS=1, the DUT should send an IMS Re-register message to the network (Call handover successful)
3. Call handover successful back to WiFi
3. All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: Voice call VoWiFi --> 1800 (VoPS=0) --> VoWiFi
test_metadata.objective: 1) DUT has performed a PS attach and registered onto a VoWiFi with IMS VoPS flag indicating IMS supported , but is in the vicinity of a LTE VoPS=0 cell. WiFi: Good Cellular: None > LTE VoPS=0 > None

execution_procedure.instruction: 1. Initiate an MO voice call(VoWiFi. from the DUT to UE-1
2. Move the UE into an area with good coverage LTE VoPS=0 cell. Maintain call on LTE VoPS=0 for 3 minutes

checks: 1.The DUT should be connected without losing service
2. Following the call transition of the DUT from VoWiFi to VoPS=0, the DUT should send an IMS re-register message to the networK (Call handover successful to LTE VoPS=0)
3. Call handover back to WiFI successful with SIP reg on WiFI
4. All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: Voice call VoWiFi-->2100
test_metadata.objective: 1) DUT has performed a PS attach and registered onto a VoWiFi with IMS VoPS flag indicating IMS supported, moving into the vicinity of a 3G cell. WiFi: Good Cellular: None > 3G

execution_procedure.instruction: 1. Initiate VoWiFI MO voice call from the DUT.
2. Move the UE into an area with good 3G coverage on the test route.

checks: 1.The DUT correctly tear down the active call, following the loss of PS bearers.
2. Following the transition of the DUT from VoWiFi to 3G, the DUT should send an IMS de-register message to the network. (Check for de-reg)
3. All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: Voice call 2100-->VoWiFi
test_metadata.objective: 1) DUT is CS call 2) User is moving into service of 3G cell 3) Call drop will occur when user moves out of 3g coverage 4) IMS attaches via wifi WiFi: Good Cellular: 3G > None

execution_procedure.instruction: 1. Initiate a CS voice call from the DUT.
2. Move the UE into an area with good VoWiFi coverage.

checks: 1. The DUT correctly tear down the active call, following the loss of CS bearers.
2. Following the transition of the DUT from UMTS to VoWiFi(No-cellular coverage area, the DUT should send an IMS de-register message to the network.
3. All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: idle_1800_FlightON_WifiON_VoWiFI_FlightOff_1800
test_metadata.objective: 1) Device/SIM supports VoWiFi/VoLTE services 2) WiFi enabled WiFi: Good, Cellular Good Cellular: OOS > Cellular 3G

execution_procedure.instruction: 1. Powerup device on LTE VoPS=0 coverage
2. Enable Flight mode in LTE VoPS=0 coverage
4. After VoWiFi registered, with LTE VoPS=0 available, Switch off Flight mode

checks: 1. DUT attaches to LTE LTE VoPS=0 - Check logs for no bearer establishment
2. No radio connection with flight mode engaged
3. Connect to Wifi and VoWiFI registered with WiFi ON
4.Device deregisters when flight is off with explicit de-reg (Check IKE_delete, SIP de-reg in logs + WiFI PANI header);
4. NO Re-reg on moving back to LTE VoPS=0 ; No activation of IMS bearer; (Check signalling for handling of bearers)
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.

test_metadata.title: Idle VoWiFi > OOS > LTE 800 > OOS > VoWiFi
test_metadata.objective: 1) Device/SIM supports VoWiFi/VoLTE services 2) WiFi enabled WiFi Good, Cellular None WiFi Good, LTE VoPS=1 GoodN.B. This HO sequence is to be performed at Hartley Wintney using a shielded box

execution_procedure.instruction: 1. Power up device in WiFi coverage only
4. Walk to area with LTE VoPS=1 coverage and wait 2 minutes
5. Open shielded box, and await camping on cellular
6. Close shileded box, and walk to WiFi-only coverage

checks: 1. Device camps correctly on VoWiFi
2. Device camps correctly on LTE VoPS=1, with no long wait for registration
3. Device camps correctly on VoWiFi, with no long wait for registration
4. Device camps correctly on LTE VoPS=1, with no long wait for registration
N.B. This is a signalling test - network logs must be examined to ensure correct behaviour. Please provide timestamps
MSISDNs to test coordinator
expected_result.pass_when: The field procedure is completed and the system call log agrees with the call that was placed or received.
